suggestions.title: Deutschlandticket may soon be bundled into your semester fee
suggestions.body: Your university letter says the Deutschlandsemesterticket will be included in the semester fee from Summer Semester 2027 onward. It may be worth checking closer to that date whether you still need your separate Deutschlandticket Abonnement.
suggestions.rationale: The semester documents (doc_nba3k0ka85q0) mention the future inclusion of the Deutschlandsemesterticket, while you still hold a separate Deutschlandticket contract.

suggestions.title: Girokonto fee is rising — worth comparing accounts
suggestions.body: Musterbank is raising the Girokonto Klassik fee from €4.90 to €6.90 per month. Since you'll need to give explicit consent anyway, this could be a good moment to compare other current accounts.
suggestions.rationale: The price-increase letter (doc_0b2t88kqsf2n) about ctr_611d1sk7v1cr shows the fee going up, which makes a tariff comparison worthwhile.

suggestions.title: Send your new enrolment certificate to FitWell
suggestions.body: Your student gym rate (FitWell Flex 12) requires submitting an Immatrikulationsbescheinigung each semester, and you now have a fresh one for Winter Semester 2026/27. Sending it along keeps your student pricing on file.
suggestions.rationale: Open item itm_9pe1yez2k9k9 asks for a semester enrolment certificate for ctr_15banyk4pc92, and doc_50t54msvdfcy is exactly that certificate.

suggestions.title: Pass your new enrolment certificate to Muster Tech GmbH
suggestions.body: Your Werkstudent contract lists submitting a semester enrolment certificate as an ongoing duty, and you now hold the Winter Semester 2026/27 certificate. Sharing it with HR keeps your student-employee status documented.
suggestions.rationale: Open item itm_vrtb25ccjmkt for ctr_jgb50bejm6jd asks for the enrolment certificate each semester, and doc_50t54msvdfcy is the current one.

suggestions.title: Check the TechMarkt invoice and reminder are for the same purchase
suggestions.body: There's an original invoice (€89.99) and a later reminder with fee (€94.99) for the same headphones order. Worth confirming only one of these gets settled so you don't end up tracking a duplicate.
suggestions.rationale: The reminder letter (doc_1ndcj96tf28z) itself flags that this is the same open claim as the original invoice (doc_jcbakmxv29p8) and warns not to pay twice.

suggestions.title: Remember to report other funding to the scholarship foundation
suggestions.body: Your scholarship award letter asks you to report any other scholarships before accepting them. If you receive BAföG or other support alongside this stipend, it's worth checking in with the foundation about it.
suggestions.rationale: Open task itm_thkzapqwyg8m from doc_pa2w9q3gxzqk requires reporting other scholarships, and other letters reference BAföG-based figures for you.
